stories.title: Purandar airport land acquisition nears completion
stories.summary: The district administration has acquired 973 hectares of the 1,216 hectares required for the proposed Chhatrapati Sambhajiraje International Airport. Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis stated that tenders will be floated soon, though the project currently lacks a clear timeline for the next phase.

stories.title: Government expects strong US trade deal
stories.summary: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal said India has negotiated a strong set of outcomes and expects one of its best trade deals with the US. The two nations finalised a framework for the first phase of a bilateral agreement in February. Changes in the text remain ongoing.

stories.title: Modi calls for natural farming and crop diversification
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi urged farmers to move beyond wheat, rice and sugarcane to improve prosperity. He also encouraged a shift toward natural farming to protect soil health. During the conference, the Prime Minister noted that the media prefers controversies over agricultural topics.

stories.title: India pays record $6.4 billion for Russian crude in October
stories.summary: India paid a record $6.43 billion for Russian crude oil in October, according to the Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air. The total cost was driven up by rising oil prices and increased freight costs following the closure of the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Retail inflation breaches 6 percent limit
stories.summary: Retail inflation reached 6.09 percent in October, exceeding the Reserve Bank of India's upper tolerance limit for the first time in two years. Food inflation rose to 8.94 percent, with 11 of 12 tracked categories showing hardening prices. Another interest rate hike is now considered likely.

stories.title: PLI schemes meet 28 percent of employment targets
stories.summary: India's production-linked incentive schemes have reached 76 percent of investment targets but only 28 percent of employment goals, according to NITI Aayog. The report highlights an uneven translation of the government's manufacturing push into job creation after more than half the implementation period.

stories.title: Fertilizer subsidy outgo exceeds budget
stories.summary: The Union Cabinet approved a fertilizer subsidy of 62,370 crore rupees for the Rabi season, pushing the total annual outgo past 1 lakh crore rupees against a 54,000 crore rupee budget. Global price surges following the Iran war may push total annual spending toward 3 lakh crore rupees.

stories.title: Cabinet approves ₹62,370-crore fertiliser subsidy for Rabi season
stories.summary: The Union Cabinet on Wednesday approved a fertiliser subsidy package of Rs 62,370 crore for the Rabi 2026-27 season, a 64 per cent increase over the Rs 37,952 crore allocated for the previous Rabi season, with provisions to keep Di-ammonium Phosphate (DAP) available to farmers

stories.title: Pink Line metro costs rise to 17,346 crore rupees
stories.summary: Prime Minister Modi will inaugurate a 7.5-km stretch of Bengaluru's Pink Line on November 13. The total cost for the 21.26-km corridor has risen to 17,346 crore rupees from an original estimate of 8,730 crore rupees. The state government is responsible for approximately 12,000 crore rupees.

stories.title: Modi to inaugurate MRPL terminal in Bengaluru
stories.summary: Prime Minister Modi will dedicate a 330-crore rupee marketing terminal in Bengaluru to the nation on November 13. The 20-acre facility is connected to the Mangaluru refinery via a 363-km pipeline and holds 77,000 kilolitres of fuel to support regional industrial needs.

stories.title: India's retail inflation rises to 6.09% in October, breaches RBI limit
stories.summary: India’s retail inflation, measured by the Consumer Price Index (CPI), rose to 6.09 per cent in October 2026 from 5.54 per cent in September, marking its highest level since October 2024, when it stood at 6.21 per cent, according to data released by the Ministry

stories.title: Markets extend winning streak to third day
stories.summary: Benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty ended marginally higher on Thursday, marking a third consecutive day of gains. The Sensex closed at 81,911.01, supported by foreign institutional inflows and lower crude oil prices. Banking and financial stocks led the session, while automobile shares lagged.

stories.title: India overtakes Taiwan to regain fifth-largest stock market position globally
stories.summary: India has regained its position as the world’s fifth-largest stock market, with the value of its listed equities rising to $5.4 trillion and overtaking Taiwan after a sharp rebound in domestic shares. The US, China, Japan and Hong Kong remain the four larger markets, according

stories.title: Rupee hits one-week low against dollar
stories.summary: The rupee closed at 94.04 per dollar on Thursday, marking its weakest level in a week. Analysts attributed the decline to aggressive dollar demand from a state-owned bank ahead of inflation data and broad-based strength in the greenback. The currency last breached 94 in March 2026.

stories.title: Nifty Ends at 25,299 as Nifty Bank Surges 1.19%, Realty Jumps 4.5% and Insurers Rally on Strong October Premium Data | I
stories.summary: 12 Nov 2026 , 05:57 PM Indian benchmark indices ended marginally higher on November 12, 2026, with Nifty rising 44.30 points to 25,299.35 and Sensex adding 31.61 points to 81,911.01, as strong buying in banking and financial stocks offset weakness in Auto, FMCG and IT.

stories.title: Sensex and Nifty end flat after volatile session
stories.summary: Indian benchmark indices closed marginally higher on Thursday after a volatile trading session. While foreign inflows supported the market, profit booking in heavyweights and elevated US bond yields capped gains. Over 2,400 stocks advanced on the BSE, though Page Industries fell after a regulatory setback.

stories.title: Foreign inflows boost Indian equity returns in dollar terms
stories.summary: A surge in foreign investment has helped the rupee recover, improving returns for overseas investors. The Nifty 50 rose 11 percent in dollar terms between 30 October and 11 November, outpacing its 9.5 percent gain in rupee terms. Dollar returns remain a primary focus for foreign capital.

stories.title: Gift Nifty signals flat opening for Indian markets
stories.summary: Gift Nifty futures point to a flat start for the Sensex and Nifty on Friday. Benchmarks ended marginally higher on Thursday as profit booking and US bond yields limited upward momentum. Asian stocks fell during the session, while crude oil prices eased on hopes for peace talks.

stories.title: Benchmark indices pause after recent rally
stories.summary: Indian equity indices ended marginally higher on Thursday after a volatile session. Investors appeared to take a breather following a sharp rally driven by foreign inflows and softer oil prices. Positive domestic cues were offset by profit booking in select heavyweight stocks and rising US bond yields.

stories.title: Markets extend gains for third consecutive day
stories.summary: The BSE Sensex rose 0.04 percent to 81,911, while the Nifty 50 gained 0.18 percent to 25,299. Foreign institutional investors purchased over 12,500 crore rupees of equities on Wednesday. Brent crude dipped to 92.50 dollars per barrel as the rupee opened at 93 against the dollar.

stories.title: Rupee falls 33 paise against US dollar
stories.summary: The rupee depreciated to 94.04 against the dollar on Thursday, weighed down by a stronger American currency. Forex traders cited a hawkish Federal Reserve speech and rising expectations for a December rate hike. The local unit had opened at 93.73 before sliding during the trading day.

stories.title: Advent International struggles to find buyer for stake
stories.summary: Advent International is in advanced negotiations to sell its stake in DFM Foods after failing to secure interest from several major strategic buyers. Potential bidders including Britannia, Marico and Lotte reportedly exited the process, citing the steep valuation quoted by the private equity firm.

stories.title: Mars sees growth potential in India following acquisition
stories.summary: Mars expects its India business to more than double following the 36 billion dollar acquisition of Kellanova. While demand is showing signs of recovery, the company warned that progress remains fragile. Rising oil prices and a fresh wave of inflation continue to pose risks to consumer spending.

stories.title: Bodhi Tree Systems invests 180 million dollars in A2B
stories.summary: Bodhi Tree Systems has announced a 180 million dollar investment in Adyar Ananda Bhavan. The partnership aims to modernise the chain's kitchens, expand its packaged foods range and grow its restaurant footprint. Uday Shankar will serve as chairperson of the sweets and savouries brand.

stories.title: Adyar Ananda Bhavan sells majority stake to Bodhi Tree
stories.summary: Chennai-based restaurant chain Adyar Ananda Bhavan has sold a majority stake to Bodhi Tree Systems for 180 million dollars. The investment platform, founded by James Murdoch and Uday Shankar, plans to back the brand's digital transformation and global expansion as it scales its operations.

stories.title: SoftBank-backed entity plans Meesho block deal
stories.summary: A SoftBank-backed entity is expected to sell a 1 percent stake in Meesho worth 1,174 crore rupees. The floor price represents a 3.1 percent discount to Thursday's closing price. Meesho recently reported a 67.8 percent year-on-year reduction in its consolidated net loss.

stories.title: Adani Group plans equity push for Evos acquisition
stories.summary: The Adani Group is preparing a 1.45 billion dollar equity investment to support its 2.9 billion dollar takeover of Dutch storage company Evos. The conglomerate plans to cover half the cost with its own capital and arrange the remainder through syndicated borrowing to refinance existing debt.

stories.title: NCLT approves merger of Jana Holdings and Jana Capital
stories.summary: The National Company Law Tribunal has approved the amalgamation of Jana Holdings with Jana Capital. The merger aims to eliminate the non-operative financial holding company layer within the promoter group of Jana Small Finance Bank. Jana Holdings will be dissolved following the transition of assets.

stories.title: Bodhi Tree Systems acquires majority stake in A2B
stories.summary: Bodhi Tree Systems has acquired a majority stake in Adyar Ananda Bhavan for 180 million dollars. The investment is intended to fuel the snack chain's domestic and international expansion. The specific size of the stake and the company's final valuation were not disclosed by the parties.

stories.title: Adani seeks 2.5 billion dollar loan for debt refinancing
stories.summary: The full piece is for subscribers. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: Fairfax offers premium for IDBI Bank stake
stories.summary: Fairfax, led by Prem Watsa, offered 81 rupees per share for a 60.72 percent stake in IDBI Bank. The bid represents a 56 percent premium to the bank's regulatory book value and is higher than the share price on the day before final offers were invited.

stories.title: Godrej Capital raises 2,500 crore rupees from Temasek
stories.summary: Godrej Capital has secured 2,500 crore rupees from Singapore's Temasek Holdings at a valuation of 28,000 crore rupees. Godrej Industries Group will retain approximately 80 percent ownership in the financial services arm following the investment, which was made through an affiliate.

stories.title: India reportedly plans to restrict private equity lenders
stories.summary: The full piece is for subscribers. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: Power firms seek protection from project delays
stories.summary: The Electric Power Transmission Association has requested changes to the tariff-based bidding framework for inter-state projects. The group seeks full tariff recovery and protection against penalties when commissioning is delayed by interconnected facilities. Transmission projects are increasingly interdependent, and one provider is often waiting on another.

stories.title: Health insurance waiting periods explained
stories.summary: Health insurance policies require an initial waiting period, typically 30 days, before non-accidental claims are covered. Pre-existing conditions like diabetes or asthma carry longer waiting periods. Policyholders are advised to check if these periods can be reduced or waived, as coverage is not immediate upon purchase.

stories.title: IMF raises India's medium-term growth potential
stories.summary: The IMF has upgraded India's medium-term potential growth estimate to 6.8 percent from 6.5 percent. The fund cites favourable demographics and structural reforms as key drivers. Achieving this target will require stronger private investment and faster creation of high-quality jobs to sustain the current momentum.

stories.title: Feed makers seek government intervention on costs
stories.summary: Livestock feed makers are requesting government intervention as maize prices have reached historic highs, jumping 30 to 40 percent in recent weeks. The industry attributes the surge to a domestic crop shortfall and rising demand from ethanol producers. The feed sector is currently suggesting short-term import measures.

stories.title: PLI schemes show uneven benefits for MSMEs
stories.summary: A NITI Aayog and IIM Ahmedabad assessment finds that while PLI schemes attracted 2.40 trillion rupees in investment, benefits for smaller enterprises remain largely indirect. Employment generation across the 14 sectors has reached only 28 percent of the government's target as of March 2026.

stories.title: FISME pushes for export studies and testing upgrades
stories.summary: The Federation of Indian Micro and Small and Medium Enterprises has urged the government to conduct market-specific studies across 10 priority sectors. The industry body seeks better testing facilities to help smaller exporters navigate regulatory requirements and compliance costs when utilising India's existing free trade agreements.

stories.title: Direct tax target remains within reach
stories.summary: The government has collected 53 percent of its 26.97 lakh crore rupee direct tax target as of November 10. Experts suggest the full-year goal is achievable, provided collections from corporate and advance tax instalments accelerate during the second half of the fiscal year.

stories.title: RBI considers limits on private equity control of NBFCs
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India is reportedly weighing a plan to bar private equity firms from holding controlling stakes in more than one non-banking financial company. Stakes of 15 percent or less would face lighter scrutiny. The proposal is currently under discussion and not yet a rule.

stories.title: Gartner forecasts net job growth from AI
stories.summary: Gartner expects AI to create 10.6 million jobs while eliminating 8.9 million by 2030, resulting in a net increase of 1.7 million. The firm notes that 5 million people will experience delayed hiring as executives postpone creating positions. Deferred jobs are not the same as lost jobs.

stories.title: Direct tax collections show growth
stories.summary: Net direct tax collection reached 14.42 lakh crore rupees by November 10, marking an 11.76 percent year-on-year growth. The government has achieved 53 percent of its budgeted target for the fiscal year. Meeting the full-year goal will depend on collections in the second half.

stories.title: RBI weighs risks of private equity in shadow banking
stories.summary: The RBI is considering curbs on private equity firms controlling multiple non-bank lenders. The central bank is concerned that financial stress at a global firm could trigger a contagion effect across its investments. Authorities hope to encourage smaller financial investments that will be subject to less scrutiny.
